decisions.reason: The citrus harvesting crate was a flagship in reusable agricultural packaging, and its absence from the website in 2020–2021 weakens the signal without proving failure, so the cheap option stays open a while longer.
Foldable large containers are core to the returnable packaging business and cost little to keep in the catalogue, so missing website visibility alone does not justify abandonment.
The stackable crate line runs on existing tooling at minimal holding cost, but it was only briefly mentioned and then disappeared from view, which raises the risk it is quietly phased out.
The spill-retention pallet serves a steady niche industrial need with low maintenance cost, so the option is worth holding despite the lack of recent website evidence.
The pallet with load retainers is a specialized variant with low holding cost, and two years without visibility make it a candidate for review rather than immediate withdrawal.
